---
title: "Explore hierarchical clustering"
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

Agglomerative hierarchical clustering starts with every observation in its own
cluster, then repeatedly merges clusters. This explorer uses **single linkage**:
the distance between two clusters is the distance between their closest pair of
points.

::: {.callout-tip}
## What to watch

The two highlighted groups are the next pair to merge. On the left, their
closest pair of points is joined by a dashed line. On the right, that same
merge adds one branch to the dendrogram. A final horizontal cut through a
dendrogram turns the nested hierarchy into a chosen number of clusters.
:::

The fixed `make_moons` sample contains 36 observations. Its generating labels
are not used. Single linkage can follow the two curved groups because it grows
clusters through nearby points rather than around centroids.

<div id="hierarchical-explorer" class="hierarchical-explorer" aria-label="Interactive hierarchical clustering explorer">

    <button id="hierarchical-next" type="button" class="regression-sampling-primary">Next merge</button>
    <button id="hierarchical-play" type="button">Play</button>
    <button id="hierarchical-reset" type="button">Reset</button>
    <output id="hierarchical-progress" class="hierarchical-progress" aria-live="polite">Loading data…</output>
  </div>
  <div class="hierarchical-workbench">
    <section class="hierarchical-panel" aria-labelledby="hierarchical-points-title">
      <div class="hierarchical-panel-heading"><h2 id="hierarchical-points-title">Current clusters</h2><p>Each point starts alone. A merge combines two whole clusters.</p></div>
      <svg id="hierarchical-plot" viewBox="0 0 620 480" role="img" aria-label="Two-moon observations and the clusters merged at each step"></svg>
      <div class="hierarchical-legend"><span><i class="hierarchical-key"></i>Current cluster</span><span><i class="hierarchical-key hierarchical-key-left"></i>One merging cluster</span><span><i class="hierarchical-key hierarchical-key-right"></i>Other merging cluster</span><span><i class="hierarchical-key hierarchical-key-line"></i>Closest pair</span></div>
    </section>
    <section class="hierarchical-panel hierarchical-dendrogram-panel" aria-labelledby="hierarchical-tree-title">

      <svg id="hierarchical-dendrogram" viewBox="0 0 620 480" role="img" aria-label="Growing single-linkage dendrogram"></svg>
      <p class="hierarchical-note">The leaf order only makes the tree readable; it is not an additional feature of the data.</p>
    </section>
  </div>
  <section class="hierarchical-summary" aria-labelledby="hierarchical-summary-title">

      <p id="hierarchical-explanation" class="hierarchical-explanation"></p>

    <div class="hierarchical-metrics">

      <div><span>Most recent merge distance</span><strong id="hierarchical-distance">—</strong></div>
      <div><span>Linkage</span><strong>Single</strong></div>
      <div><span>Merges completed</span><strong id="hierarchical-merge-count">—</strong></div>
    </div>
  </section>
</div>
